data.providerDisplayDescription: DeFi and crypto analytics — TVL by protocol and chain, token prices, stablecoins, yields, fees/revenue, DEX and perp volumes, token unlocks, raises, hacks, treasuries, bridges, RWA, ETFs, and equities across the DefiLlama Pro API.
data.displayDescription: Get financial statements for a company
data.summary: Returns income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement for the given ticker, broken down by quarterly and annual periods.

data.providerDisplayDescription: DeFi and crypto analytics — TVL by protocol and chain, token prices, stablecoins, yields, fees/revenue, DEX and perp volumes, token unlocks, raises, hacks, treasuries, bridges, RWA, ETFs, and equities across the DefiLlama Pro API.
data.displayDescription: Get filings for a company
data.summary: Returns a list of company filings (such as annual reports, quarterly reports, and other important filings) for the given ticker, sorted by filing date descending (newest first).

data.providerDisplayDescription: DeFi and crypto analytics — TVL by protocol and chain, token prices, stablecoins, yields, fees/revenue, DEX and perp volumes, token unlocks, raises, hacks, treasuries, bridges, RWA, ETFs, and equities across the DefiLlama Pro API.
data.displayDescription: Get live market summary for a company
data.summary: Returns current market data for a single ticker. This is a compact snapshot (no `ticker` / `name` fields); use `GET /equities/v1/companies-list` for the list of tracked companies with their identity details.

data.providerDisplayDescription: DeFi and crypto analytics — TVL by protocol and chain, token prices, stablecoins, yields, fees/revenue, DEX and perp volumes, token unlocks, raises, hacks, treasuries, bridges, RWA, ETFs, and equities across the DefiLlama Pro API.
data.displayDescription: Get historical price data for a company
data.summary: Returns closing prices as two-element arrays: ISO 8601 date-time string, then numeric price. Sorted by date descending (newest first). Resolution follows `timeframe`: `1D`, `7D` and `1W` are 5-minute intraday bars whose date-time carries a real time of day, while `1M` and longer are daily closes stamped `T00:00:00Z`.

data.providerDisplayDescription: DeFi and crypto analytics — TVL by protocol and chain, token prices, stablecoins, yields, fees/revenue, DEX and perp volumes, token unlocks, raises, hacks, treasuries, bridges, RWA, ETFs, and equities across the DefiLlama Pro API.
data.displayDescription: Get list of all tracked public companies
data.summary: Returns a list of all publicly traded companies tracked by DefiLlama, with company identity and country.

data.providerDisplayDescription: DeFi and crypto analytics — TVL by protocol and chain, token prices, stablecoins, yields, fees/revenue, DEX and perp volumes, token unlocks, raises, hacks, treasuries, bridges, RWA, ETFs, and equities across the DefiLlama Pro API.
data.displayDescription: Get OHLCV candle data for a company
data.summary: Returns OHLCV bars as six-number arrays: Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC), open, high, low, close, volume. Sorted by time descending (newest first). Optional `timeframe` controls both how far back data goes and the bar resolution: `1D`, `7D` and `1W` return 5-minute bars, `1M` and longer return daily bars. Omit or empty for full history (`MAX`).

data.providerDisplayDescription: DeFi and crypto analytics — TVL by protocol and chain, token prices, stablecoins, yields, fees/revenue, DEX and perp volumes, token unlocks, raises, hacks, treasuries, bridges, RWA, ETFs, and equities across the DefiLlama Pro API.
data.displayDescription: Get on-chain tradeable markets for a company
data.summary: Returns where the stock can be traded on-chain: `perps` are perpetual futures markets across exchanges, and `tokens` are tokenised-equity issuers. This is a live snapshot refreshed hourly and no history is kept. On-chain data is only collected for US-listed tickers, so a ticker in another market comes back with empty `perps` and `tokens` arrays rather than an error.

data.providerDisplayDescription: DeFi and crypto analytics — TVL by protocol and chain, token prices, stablecoins, yields, fees/revenue, DEX and perp volumes, token unlocks, raises, hacks, treasuries, bridges, RWA, ETFs, and equities across the DefiLlama Pro API.
data.displayDescription: Get financial dimensions for a company
data.summary: Returns time-series financial dimension metrics (revenue, holders revenue, earnings, and basic shares outstanding) for the given ticker, each broken down into annual and quarterly series. Every data point is a two-element array: ISO 8601 period-ending date, then the numeric value. Series are sorted by date descending (newest first).
